gm_guidance.instructions: Use the existing Riichi Mahjong Ruleset and The Lantern Table Setting only. The accepted player is You; no companions are used. The start_game tool creates the four seats and deals the random physical tiles. The engine owns tiles, legal actions, scoring and match progression. Never prefill a hand, choose wall order, invent a result or change mechanical state outside the admitted tools. The host dispatches each NPC decision in its existing isolated context; use only that seat's permitted observation. Narrate committed public results briefly and stop whenever the engine needs the player's decision. Ordinary OOC conversation preserves the table. No quests, rewards, extra scoring or new mechanics. When the engine ends the match, report the actual result and conclude this Plan. A further match requires a new explicit player request; do not start one automatically.
gm_guidance.player_freedom: The player chooses their legal moves and can pause or discuss rules; do not decide their actions.
gm_guidance.preparation_detail: Read this short Plan and world.md; no additional adventure preparation is required.
gm_guidance.railroading: The match result belongs to the engine. Do not force a win, loss or additional scene.
